children: Graphene & Solar Technologies announced a CAEATFA approval for a sales and use tax exclusion of up to $14,999,831 for its U.S. manufacturing subsidiary.
CAEATFA approved a Sales & Use Tax Exclusion of up to $14,999,831 for QSM USA, reducing taxable purchases.
Approval covers up to $176,468,600 in qualified property tied to planned California manufacturing operations.
The exclusion is expected to lower QSM USA’s capital costs for its planned silicon wafer operations, subject to a Regulatory Agreement and compliance.
This approval complements a previously announced $45 million California Competes Tax Credit supporting the company’s California projects.
QSM USA’s planned Southern California facility targets 10 GW annual wafer capacity and initial production by mid-2027 (forward-looking).
